items.prompt: A small log cabin in a forest clearing in early spring: snow melted down to the grass around an old log beehive at the corner, a wooden well a few steps from the door, smoke from the chimney, a family of three approaching on foot.

alt.ru: Маленький сруб на лесной поляне ранней весной: у старой колоды-улья снег растаял до травы, в нескольких шагах колодец, из трубы дым, к избушке пешком подходят трое.
alt.en: A small log cabin in a forest clearing in early spring: snow melted to the grass by an old log beehive, a well a few steps away, chimney smoke, a family of three approaching on foot.
alt.pt: Uma pequena cabana de troncos numa clareira no início da primavera: neve derretida até à relva junto a uma velha colmeia, um poço a poucos passos, fumo na chaminé, uma família de três a chegar a pé.
alt.es: Una pequeña cabaña de troncos en un claro a principios de primavera: nieve derretida hasta la hierba junto a una vieja colmena de tronco, un pozo a pocos pasos, humo en la chimenea, una familia de tres llegando a pie.

items.prompt: A forest road at dusk in early spring, puddles and patches of snow: a father walks away from us carrying a tired girl of about ten on his back, her arms around his neck; a woman walks beside them.

alt.ru: Лесная дорога в весенних сумерках, лужи и остатки снега: отец уходит, неся на спине уставшую девочку лет десяти, обнявшую его за шею, рядом идёт женщина.
alt.en: A forest road at spring dusk, puddles and patches of snow: a father walks away carrying a tired girl of about ten on his back, her arms round his neck, a woman beside them.
alt.pt: Uma estrada na floresta ao anoitecer de primavera, poças e restos de neve: um pai afasta-se com uma menina cansada de uns dez anos às costas, braços ao pescoço dele, uma mulher ao lado.
alt.es: Un camino forestal al anochecer de primavera, charcos y restos de nieve: un padre se aleja con una niña cansada de unos diez años a la espalda, abrazada a su cuello, una mujer a su lado.
